questions.question: What command opens Psalm 37?
options: Hide yourself from the coming wrath
Fret not yourself because of evildoers
Cry aloud against the wicked rulers
Boast not yourself before the mighty
questions.answer: Fret not yourself because of evildoers

questions.question: What promise is given to those who delight in the LORD?
options: He will repay all of your enemies double
He will give you the desires of your heart
He will lift you up high above the nations
He will fill all of your barns with grain
questions.answer: He will give you the desires of your heart

questions.question: The psalm says the meek shall inherit the land and delight in abundant peace.
Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will _____ it.
The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD, who takes _____ in his journey.
